topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Code of conduct and sanctions under POL-01 4.8; annual acknowledgment of POL-05
evidence: Code of conduct; acknowledgment report (96%); sanctions log

control_description: Board audit committee receives quarterly cyber and resilience reports from the vCISO; includes the sponsor's operating partner
Security officer, operations owner, vCISO, and system owners designated; reporting lines in POL-01
Background checks at hire; licensed operators; annual awareness training; OT role-based training
gap: 24 operators assigned to client plants have not had OT security training; field staff get awareness only at hire
remediation: Train all Utility Services operators before the observation period (POAM-012)

control_description: Policy owners and risk owners accountable through the risk register and POA&M; performance goals for directors include POA&M milestones
Inventories of systems and data support the controls
gap: Inventory of client-facing components (ROC client views, CIS client roles) not reconciled; acquired OT inventories incomplete
remediation: Reconcile the Utility Services component list for the system description

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: Policies and responsibilities communicated at hire and yearly; intranet policy library
Commitments to clients in Utility Services agreements; incident contacts
gap: No written system description; security commitments and client responsibilities (complementary user entity controls) not documented
remediation: Draft the system description and a client responsibilities schedule

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Service objectives defined in contracts and the BIA (alarm acknowledgment within 15 minutes; billing within 2 business days of schedule)
Annual SP 800-30 risk assessment with Utility Services view
Fraud risks considered in finance and billing
gap: No documented assessment of billing manipulation or refund fraud for client accounts
remediation: Add billing fraud scenarios to the risk register and test refund approvals

control_description: Significant changes assessed through the risk process
gap: Acquisitions and the 2026 interconnection were not assessed before change; STD-07 in draft
remediation: Issue STD-07 and use it for any change touching client services

control_description: Annual independent assessment by the co-sourced internal audit firm (P07); MSSP monthly reports
Deficiencies tracked in the POA&M and reported quarterly to the audit committee

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Controls selected from risks (P01) and the SSP baseline (P02)
General controls over technology defined in standards
gap: STD-01 and STD-02 still in draft
remediation: Issue STD-01 and STD-02 (P06)

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: Policies effective 2026-10-01 with supporting standards
gap: 6 of 10 standards in draft
remediation: Issue the 2026 Q4 and 2027 Q1 standards

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: SSO and MFA for all workforce; privileged access management for cloud and the OT gateway; CIS roles per client
evidence: Conditional access; PAM configuration; CIS role matrix
gap: Directory and SaaS administrators hold standing rights; 23 non-expiring service accounts
remediation: POAM-021

control_description: Accounts created from the HR feed with manager approval; client billing roles approved by the Director of Customer Service
Role changes and removal at transfer and termination; access reviews
gap: Annual reviews only; 4 of 25 leavers kept OT local accounts; 2 of 25 transfers kept prior access
remediation: Quarterly reviews; OT accounts on checklists (POAM-003)

control_description: Badge access and cameras at headquarters, the ROC, and plants; quarterly badge review
evidence: Badge reports; P07 PE-3 (major sites satisfied)

control_description: Media and records disposed of under STD-05 with certificates

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: Boundary protection for business IT and the Regional OT DMZ; client read-only links behind dedicated firewalls
gap: Any-to-any site-to-site tunnels and unmanaged remote paths into Lakes and Ridge share the ROC network with client monitoring
remediation: POAM-001 and POAM-002

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: Encryption in transit for SaaS, VPNs, the gateway, and client links

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: EDR on all managed endpoints; application allowlisting on ROC engineering workstations

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: Vulnerability and configuration monitoring
gap: No OT vulnerability identification outside Regional; STD-09 lacks OT; no drift monitoring for ROC client views
remediation: STD-09 OT update; quarterly exposure scans (POAM-013)

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: MSSP 24x7 monitoring of IT and Regional OT
gap: OT alerts reach the ROC late; no CIS bulk-export alerting
remediation: POAM-008 and POAM-023

control_description: Security events evaluated by the MSSP and the IRT
gap: No OT playbooks; decision log new
remediation: POAM-008; POAM-023

control_description: Incident response policy and two runbooks with client notice within 24 hours
gap: Runbooks not yet exercised
remediation: OT tabletop 2026-11-17; ransomware tabletop 2027-02-24

control_description: Recovery from incidents
gap: No tested restore of company CIS data; no alternate ROC position for client monitoring
remediation: Weekly CIS export and restore test; alternate ROC position (POAM-018)

control_description: Change tickets for IT and Regional OT; CIS configuration changes by the Director of Customer Service
gap: CIS rate table and billing rule changes for clients lack a second reviewer
remediation: Second-person approval for client billing configuration

control_description: Business disruption risks identified in the BIA and mitigated
gap: Single ROC with no alternate position; client monitoring falls back to clients' own dialers
remediation: POAM-018

topic_label: Vendor and business partner risk management
control_description: Vendor and business partner risk management
gap: Vendors reviewed only at onboarding before 2026-09; reviews in this file are the first cycle
remediation: STD-08; complete Tier 1 reviews (POAM-014)

control_description: ROC staffing and alarm capacity monitored; client alarm volumes reviewed monthly
Environmental protections, backups, and recovery infrastructure: UPS and generator at the ROC; daily immutable backups; CIS vendor DR

remediation: Alternate ROC position (POAM-018); separate client alarm queue

control_description: Recovery plan testing
gap: No test of client monitoring failover or of CIS data restore
remediation: Failover test with the alternate position; CIS restore test

control_description: Client data identified and classified Confidential; separate CIS role per client
gap: Client data held outside the CIS (exports in file services) not tracked
remediation: Inventory and restrict client data exports

control_description: Disposal of confidential information under STD-05 and contract exit terms

control_description: Meter read inputs validated by CIS edit checks (high, low, zero usage) and AMI read success reports

control_description: Bill print file reviewed before release to the print vendor
